entries.title: Isaiah 12:1
segments:
CHAP. XII. 
 
  A thanksgiving of the faithful for their redemption, ver. 1-6. 
 
  V. 1. In that day-When this great work of the reduction of Israel, and conversion of the Gentiles is fulfilled.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:2
segments: V. 2. God-My salvation hath not been brought to pass by man, but by the almighty power of God.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:3
segments: V. 3. With joy-Your thirsty souls shall be filled with Divine graces and comforts, which you may draw from God, in the use of gospel-ordinances.
